_note: Reusable AI video footage. Every clip here says and shows nothing practice-specific (no city, no business name, no prices or offer details), so it can be customized per prospect with tools/library_ad.py: their colors, their real Google review card, their CTA end card. Only add footage that passes that test. Talking takes are trimmed to the usable speech.

ugc-tried-everything.says: Real talk. I've done the massages, the adjustments, even months of PT, and my back still flares up every week.
ugc-tried-everything.actor: Man, early 40s, grey t-shirt, selfie in a parked car; palm trees and desert mountains outside (reads Sun Belt / Southwest).
ugc-tried-everything.fits: Any practice. Angle: chronic pain, tried everything else. Pick a review about finally getting results after other care failed.

ugc-caregiver-mom.says: Driving my mom to PT three times a week after her knee replacement? Honestly, it was a second job.
ugc-caregiver-mom.actor: Woman, late 40s, navy quarter-zip, selfie in an SUV parked in a suburban driveway.
ugc-caregiver-mom.fits: ONLY practices that offer in-home / mobile PT (the payoff is 'PT that comes to the house'). Pick a review about in-home convenience.
ugc-caregiver-mom.caution: Same AI actor as CrosaCore's caregiver ad (Austin). Don't use it for another practice in the Austin market.

beats: POV: a 15-minute PT visit, and the therapist is juggling 3 other patients
Week 8. Still doing band exercises alone. Still in pain.
pov-rushed-pt.closer_hint: Beat 3 is the practice's own line over hands-on care, from their real facts, e.g. 'At <Practice>, every visit is a full hour. One-on-one. Hands-on.'
pov-rushed-pt.shows: 1: busy insurance-style clinic, a patient waiting while the therapist works with someone else. 2: a woman alone on a mat with a red band. 3: gloved hands-on manual therapy on a lower back, therapist's face not shown.
pov-rushed-pt.fits: Cash-pay or one-on-one practices (the contrast is rushed, crowded PT). Pick a review about fewer visits / real hands-on time.
pov-rushed-pt.source: Kling image-to-video from nano-banana-pro stills, Advantage Therapy blueprint 2026-10-05
